full_text:
Stop relying on cosine similarity scores alone to rank RAG context.

Score distribution varies wildly across different embedding spaces, making hard thresholding fail.

Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) normalizes rank positions across sparse BM25 and dense Qdrant vector streams cleanly.

In our benchmark evaluation, RRF reduced retrieval error rates from 18.4% to 2.1%.

Have you implemented RRF reranking in your production search pipelines?
